question: 'Mission Golden Spice' aims to develop which agricultural product as a Global Brand?
detail:
- Union Minister for Development of North Eastern Region **Jyotiraditya Scindia** launched **Mission Golden Spice** in **Meghalaya**.
- It is a **₹175 crore, 5-year initiative** to promote **Lakadong Turmeric** as a global brand.
- Aim: expand its cultivation from **2,600 hectares to 7,000 hectares** and raise the income of about **17,500 farmers (99% women)**.
- **Processing and Cold Storage** facilities will be developed, over **3,000 jobs** created, and access opened to new export markets like the **US, EU, Japan and Gulf**.
- **Lakadong Turmeric:** grown mainly in the **West and East Jaintia Hills of Meghalaya**; it has **7–12% curcumin** — nearly 4 times the world average — making it world-famous for its high quality.

question: The recently discussed 'Chita Andolan' (Pyre Protest) is associated with which of the following projects?
detail:
- In the **Chhatarpur and Panna districts of Madhya Pradesh**, the **Gond and Kol tribal communities** launched the **'Chita Andolan'** against the construction of the **Daudhan Dam** under the **Ken–Betwa Link Project**.
- Protesters symbolically lay on funeral pyres to convey that the loss of their land, forest, culture and livelihood is like death for them.
- The movement started on **3 July 2026** and was ended by police and administration on **19 July 2026**.
- **Main demands:** stop the project, fair compensation, land-for-land rehabilitation, and compliance with the **PESA Act, 1996** and **Forest Rights Act, 2006**.
- **Ken–Betwa Link Project (KBLP)** is **India's first river-interlinking project**, transferring surplus water from the **Ken river** to the **Betwa river** to boost irrigation, drinking water and power in **Bundelkhand**.
- **Total cost — ₹44,605 crore**; funding pattern **90% Centre, 10% States**.

question: Who became the first Indian cricketer to score an ODI century at Lord's Cricket Ground?
detail:
- India captain **Rohit Sharma** became the **first Indian cricketer to score an ODI century at Lord's**.
- In the **third ODI between India and England**, he played a brilliant knock of **138 runs** — the **34th ODI century** of his career.
- At **39 years 80 days**, he became the **oldest Indian to score an international century in all formats**, breaking **Sachin Tendulkar's** record (38 years 327 days).
- With **8 ODI centuries in England**, he became the visiting batter with the most ODI hundreds in a single foreign country.
- As an opening batter it was his **46th international century**, going past Sachin Tendulkar's 45.

question: India's first River Kinetic Energy Demonstration Project will be established in which state?
detail:
- In **July 2026**, the **Arunachal Pradesh** government signed an MoU with Norway's **Tidal Sail AS** to set up a **500 kW River Kinetic Energy Demonstration Project** — India's first such plant.
- **River Kinetic Energy** is a **hydrokinetic renewable energy technology** that generates electricity through submerged turbines using the natural flow (current) of a river — **no dam or reservoir is required**.
- Developed under the **India–Norway Green Partnership**, with support from the **Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)** and **Innovation Norway**.
- **Benefits:** clean renewable energy generation and reduced dependence on fossil fuels and carbon emissions.

question: When is National Flag Day celebrated in India?
detail:
- **National Flag Day** is observed every year on **22 July**.
- It marks the day the national flag (Tiranga) was **adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 22 July 1947**.
- **History of the Tiranga:** the first national flag was hoisted in **Calcutta on 7 August 1906**, designed by Sachindra Prasad Bose and Hemchandra Kanungo.
- In **1907, Madam Bhikaji Cama** hoisted a version abroad in Germany.
- At the **1931 Karachi session of the INC**, a resolution adopted the tricolour (designed by **Pingali Venkayya**) as the national flag.
- The **final flag adopted on 22 July 1947** kept the 1931 design but replaced the charkha (spinning wheel) with the **Ashoka Chakra**.

question: India's first utility-scale vanadium redox flow battery energy storage system (VRFB BESS) will be set up in which state?
detail:
- India has approved its first and largest utility-scale **(100 MWh) Vanadium Redox Flow Battery Energy Storage System (VRFB BESS)** at the **Khavda Solar Park in Gujarat**.
- **NTPC Renewable Energy Limited (NTPC REL)** awarded the contract to **Bondada Engineering Limited**.
- It will be commissioned in **2027** with a **10-year O&M** period.
- It is **India's first non-lithium battery energy storage system**, 100% designed, engineered and manufactured in India.
- **VRFB** is a rechargeable flow battery that uses a **vanadium-based liquid electrolyte** to store energy.

question: Which became India's first approved dengue vaccine?
detail:
- India's **Drug Controller General of India (DCGI)** granted **Market Authorisation** to **QDENGA (TAK-003)**, making it **India's first approved dengue vaccine**.
- It is approved for people aged **4 to 60 years**.
- **Developer — Takeda Biopharmaceuticals (Japan)**.
- It protects against **all four dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4)** and can be given whether or not a person has had dengue before — **no pre-vaccination screening required**. Approved in over 40 countries.
- **Dengue** is a mosquito-borne viral disease spread mainly by the **Aedes aegypti** mosquito; India carries about **one-third** of global dengue cases.
- **DCGI** is India's national drug regulator; established **1940** under the Drugs & Cosmetics Act, HQ **New Delhi**.

question: What is the name of the official mascot unveiled for the BWF World Championships, New Delhi 2026?
detail:
- Union Sports Minister **Mansukh Mandaviya** and **BAI** President **Himanta Biswa Sarma** unveiled the official mascot **'Peacko'** and the championship anthem for the **BWF World Championships, New Delhi 2026**.
- The mascot is inspired by the **Indian peacock** (India's national bird).
- The championship will be held in **New Delhi from 17–23 August 2026** — its **30th edition**, with over 400 shuttlers from 50+ countries.
- India is hosting the BWF World Championships after **17 years** (previous event in India: 2009, Hyderabad).
- **BWF World Championships:** founded **1977 (Malmö, Sweden)**; organised by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**; held every year except in Olympic years.

question: What is the name of India's first Immersive Language Museum, recently inaugurated?
detail:
- Union Home Minister **Amit Shah** inaugurated India's first **Immersive Language Museum – 'Shabdalok'** at the **National Library campus in Kolkata**.
- Developed under the **Union Ministry of Culture**, it showcases India's linguistic heritage and oral & written traditions through modern technology.
- An **immersive language museum** lets visitors experience language by seeing, hearing, touching and interacting via digital technology.
- **Features:** **9 galleries**, digital displays, holograms and motion-sensor technology tracing the journey of India's **22 official languages** from oral traditions to modern digital texts.
- **National Library, Kolkata** is India's largest public library, located in **Alipur, Kolkata**; established **1836**, with over **26 lakh** books and rare manuscripts.

question: Who has been appointed as the Additional Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)?
detail:
- The **Ministry of Railways** appointed **Rahul Himalian** as **Additional Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of IRCTC** with effect from **20 July 2026**.
- He took the additional charge after the resignation of **Sanjay Kumar Jain**, and will continue as **Director (Tourism & Marketing)**.
- He is a **1999-batch Indian Railway Traffic Service (IRTS)** officer with over 26 years of experience in Indian Railways and IRCTC.
- **IRCTC** is a PSU under the Ministry of Railways providing online rail-ticket booking, catering and tourism services; established **1999**, HQ **New Delhi**.
